video_title: The Lakers Are 11–2, Perk & RJ Debate JJ Redick’s Coach of the Year Case

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins makes his case for JJ Redick as Coach of the Year
quotes.excerpt: If I had to pick somebody in this short season, JJ Redick would win Coach of the Year.
quotes.quote: If I had to pick somebody in this short season, JJ Redick would win Coach of the Year. I was watching his team, and I wanted to know what he was going to be like post-LeBron James. JJ has the attention and the ears of that locker room that is sitting at the top of the Western Conference. He is pulling out the best of what he has. When I see that they are actually competing on both ends of the floor, JJ has the attention and the ears of that locker room that is sitting at the top of the Western Conference.
quotes.social_post: Kendrick Perkins says JJ Redick would be his Coach of the Year if the season ended today, citing the Lakers' competitiveness on both ends of the floor and how he has earned the respect of the locker room.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins debate the top teams in the West
quotes.excerpt: I think San Antonio, I think universally across the board, I think OKC universally across the board.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I think San Antonio, I think universally across the board, I think OKC universally across the board. From just kind of even, you know, GMs across the line would be like, hey, these are the two teams that we are kind of looking at to be top of the West, if healthy. Now you get to the conversation between Minnesota who just added LaMelo Ball. So that is LaMelo. Now again, Anthony Edwards goes down. Like we don't know this, but how did Anthony Edwards start the season? On a tear. How is LaMelo Ball playing? On a tear, as predicted.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Houston could be a problem, which they look like they are. So now we talking about fourth, fifth. So where you have them ranked is basically just at start of season before evaluation. We are looking at this team and saying, look, San Antonio went to the Finals, OKC won a championship. We didn't even get to mention Denver.

quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins break down the Western Conference hierarchy, highlighting the Spurs and Thunder as top contenders while noting the impact of early season performances from teams like the Rockets and Timberwolves.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains his ranking of the Lakers in the West
quotes.excerpt: I got the Lakers four or five. That's not disrespectful. That's not disrespectful to the Lakers.
quotes.quote: I got the Lakers four or five. That's not disrespectful. That's not disrespectful to the Lakers. Now the Lakers have exceeded expectations, maybe not in their own locker room, but to your point, JJ Redick has done an outstanding job. But JJ Redick is an outstanding coach. No coach is perfect, like no player is perfect. Coach is going to have a good series just like players can have a good series or bad series. So when I look at JJ, I'm like, dude, he is a great, I don't want to call him young, but he is still in the early stages of his coaching career.
quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson ranks the Lakers 4th or 5th in the West, clarifying that while JJ Redick has done an outstanding job exceeding expectations, it is not a slight to the team to place them behind other elite contenders.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues the Rockets are the best team in basketball
quotes.excerpt: The Rockets have the best team in basketball right now today.
quotes.quote: The Rockets have the best team in basketball right now today. They are better than the San Antonio Spurs right now. They are deeper. They have zero flaws. I'm watching this team and I'm saying, where is the holes? Leadership, Fred VanVleet, Marcus Smart. I'm watching this team and I'm saying, where is the holes?
quotes.social_post: Kendrick Perkins makes a bold claim that the Rockets are currently the best team in basketball, praising their depth and leadership from Fred VanVleet and Marcus Smart.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins debate the depth of the Spurs' bench
quotes.excerpt: They got Harrison Barnes, they got Keldon Johnson, they got Champagnie, they got Tobias Harris, Stephen Adams, Reid, Bogdanovic.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Go down the bench. I'll go down the bench of the Spurs. They got Harrison Barnes, they got Keldon Johnson, they got Champagnie, they got Tobias Harris, Stephen Adams, Reid, Bogdanovic. I'm telling you, San Antonio's bench is deeper.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Marcus Smart had a better playoffs than Keldon Johnson. Keldon Johnson in the playoffs, nowhere to be found. And what I'm saying is this, Richard, their starting five right now, San Antonio, perfection. The drop-off of when it goes to the bench is where the problem is.

quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins debate the depth of the Spurs, with Perkins arguing that while the starting five is strong, the drop-off to the bench remains a significant concern for the team.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson discusses the impact of adding Jaylen Brown to the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: They didn't just add LeBron James, they added Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: They didn't just add LeBron James, they added Jaylen Brown. So they added a supercharged version, a younger version of Paul George, who's hungry and going to go get it. So you add that, so that should lower his usage rate. You add LeBron James, that lowers your usage rate. So now just your overall rhythm and feel for the first time maybe in your career is completely different.
quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson discusses how the addition of Jaylen Brown and LeBron James changes the usage rate and overall rhythm for players on the team.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson reflects on playing against a 41-year-old Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I played against a 41-year-old Michael Jordan.
quotes.quote: I played against a 41-year-old Michael Jordan. I'm not going to disrespect MJ, but I'm saying it was like you were going in there with containment ideas and he didn't have a team this good. You were like, oh, let's contain him. He still hit us for 40 one game. But my point is is that even at that space, Michael Jordan and his team and what they were doing, it was more of like, it was a contain versus like, yo, Jordan at 32 was going for averaging 30 a night.
quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson reflects on playing against a 41-year-old Michael Jordan, noting that even at that stage of his career, Jordan was still capable of dropping 40 points on a team.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating the value of an MVP award from a former teammate
quotes.excerpt: You can't take an MVP from somebody either.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I can't sit up here and downplay. You can't take an MVP from somebody either.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: No, you can't. That's why I would never downplay Charles Barkley and what he did for the game.

quotes.social_post: Kendrick Perkins emphasizes the importance of respecting past legends, stating he would never downplay the impact Charles Barkley had on the game.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Defining the criteria for the 75 greatest players of all time
quotes.excerpt: It's not just about stats. It's about your greatness and your impact on the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: You got a quite a few 75 greatest of all time that don't have a ring. And let's be real. If you're 75 greatest in the history of a sport, doesn't matter if you were a part of that club. Is Damian Lillard one? Yes. Is Russell Westbrook a winner? You got 75 greatest that didn't win a championship. So that's not the only. And it's not just about stats. It's about your greatness and your impact on the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Is James Harden a winner? Yes. James Harden a winner. Yes, yes.

quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson discusses the criteria for the NBA 75 list, arguing that greatness and impact on the game are more important than just winning a championship ring.
